hypothesis: Each of the nine runtime-status-v1 codes is reachable with declared inputs, codes change along one-parameter paths exactly as the documented decision order predicts, and the runtime refuses the five host-owned codes.
input_data: Seven paths: required margin 0..3; level 5..-1; stability a in [-1, 1] for [[a, 1], [-1, a]]; state direction 0..90 degrees for diag(-1, 1); matrix scale 2^0..2^1023; theta across [-1, 1]; theta_dot across [-0.2, 0.2]
8 candidate P that NumPy calls positive definite but are exactly indefinite (seed 1041) evaluated along their weak direction
Host-owned codes MODEL_MISMATCH, STALE_STATE, INVALID_SENSOR_DATA, CERTIFICATE_EXPIRED, RUNTIME_FAULT
mathematical_model: Decision order: outside box -> NUMERICAL_OVERFLOW -> CERTIFICATE_NOT_POSITIVE (min eig P <= 0 or V < 0) -> OUTSIDE_LEVEL_SET -> NOT_CERTIFIED (x^T M x > res |x|^2) -> CERTIFIED_WITH_MARGIN / MARGIN_LOW (margin > res, MARGIN_LOW iff margin <= required margin) -> DECREASE_NOT_DEFINITE (max eig M > res) -> NUMERICAL_INCONCLUSIVE.
numerical_result: Codes reached: 9/9 (['CERTIFICATE_NOT_POSITIVE', 'CERTIFIED_WITH_MARGIN', 'DECREASE_NOT_DEFINITE', 'MARGIN_LOW', 'NOT_CERTIFIED', 'NUMERICAL_INCONCLUSIVE', 'NUMERICAL_OVERFLOW', 'OUTSIDE_LEVEL_SET', 'OUTSIDE_PARAMETER_BOX']); rounding-free codes on the paths: 8/8. 0 of 37 path steps differ from the CIW transcription of the documented order. Indefinite-P witnesses: {'CERTIFICATE_NOT_POSITIVE': 6, 'NUMERICAL_INCONCLUSIVE': 2} (0 certifying). Host-owned codes refused: 5/5. Constants: resolution factor 1.0, policy float64-decrease-v1.

title: Test every runtime status transition.
uncertainty: Path codes are far from thresholds and platform-independent. The indefinite-P witnesses depend on eigvalsh and dot-product rounding, so only their non-certification is checked and CERTIFICATE_NOT_POSITIVE reachability is recorded.
unresolved_assumptions: CERTIFICATE_NOT_POSITIVE is reached only when a P accepted by quadratic() evaluates V < 0, which depends on eigvalsh rounding; min eig P <= 0 cannot follow a passed construction check. Its reachability is therefore recorded, not required.
The CIW transcription shares the documented specification with the runtime, so it checks implementation against specification (a same-specification check), not the specification itself.
